panels.title: 失敗率（成員 × repo；failed+errored / (total - canceled)）
panels.description: 排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。對照月報第 1 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT member, repo, status, is_failure FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELED') AS denom, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED') AS fails FROM base GROUP BY member, repo), overall AS (SELECT member, 'Overall' AS repo, SUM(denom) AS denom, SUM(fails) AS fails FROM agg GROUP BY member) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN fails || '/' || denom || ' (' || ROUND(fails::numeric * 100 / denom, 1) || '%)' ELSE '-' END AS rate FROM (SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 0 AS ord FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 1 AS ord FROM overall) combined ORDER BY member, ord, repo

panels.title: 失敗成本（成員 × repo；GHA Linux $0.008/min）
panels.description: (failed+errored) duration 加總 × $0.008/min。canceled 不計。對照月報第 2 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT member, repo, COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds) FILTER (WHERE is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED'), 0) / 60.0 * 0.008 AS cost FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN cost > 0 THEN '$' || to_char(cost, 'FM999990.00') ELSE '-' END AS cost FROM base ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR 迭代次數（成員 × repo；builds / PRs）
panels.description: 理想 = 1.0；越高代表 PR 反覆推 commit。對照月報第 3 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH pr_builds AS (SELECT member, repo, pr_number, COUNT(*) AS build_count FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND is_pull_request AND pr_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY member, repo, pr_number), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, SUM(build_count)::int AS builds, COUNT(*)::int AS prs FROM pr_builds GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN prs > 0 THEN builds || '/' || prs || ' (' || to_char(builds::float / prs, 'FM990.0') || ')' ELSE '-' END AS iteration FROM agg ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR size × Review latency（中位 / p90 / p100，含未 review lower bound，小時）
panels.description: 對照月報第 4 表。未 review PR 用「now（或月底）- ready_at」當 lower bound。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(first_review_at, merged_at, closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h, (first_review_at IS NULL) AS unreviewed FROM dpv_pull_requests WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bucket IS NOT NULL), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, median, p90, p100, n, unreviewed FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Lifecycle p90（Pickup / Approval / Merge，小時）

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr_created_at AS created, member, repo, number AS pr_number, size_bucket AS size, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(first_review_at, merged_at, closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - ready_at)) / 3600.0, 1) AS latency_h, (closed_at IS NULL AND merged_at IS NULL) AS opening, 'https://github.com/' || repo || '/pull/' || number AS url FROM dpv_pull_requests WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND ready_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latency_h DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: PR review latency（成員 × size；中位 / p90 (n=N)，小時）

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_review_at - ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS pickup_h, time_to_approval::float / 3600.0 AS approval_h, time_to_merge::float / 3600.0 AS merge_h FROM dpv_pull_requests WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bucket IS NOT NULL), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pickup_h) AS pickup_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY approval_h) AS approval_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY merge_h) AS merge_p90_raw, COUNT(*)::text AS n FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pickup_h) AS pickup_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY approval_h) AS approval_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY merge_h) AS merge_p90_raw, COUNT(*)::text AS n FROM base), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN pickup_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(pickup_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(pickup_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS pickup_p90, CASE WHEN approval_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(approval_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(approval_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS approval_p90, CASE WHEN merge_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(merge_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(merge_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS merge_p90, n FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Review latency 週趨勢（各 size bucket median，小時）
panels.description: 每週各 size bucket 的 median review latency，含未 review lower bound。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS time, repo AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) / 60.0 AS value FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND status = 'PASSED' AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 每日 passed build 中位時間（每 repo 一條，分鐘）
panels.description: 對照月報第 6 項。passed only，不過濾成員。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT member, size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(first_review_at, merged_at, closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h FROM dpv_pull_requests WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bucket IS NOT NULL) SELECT member, size_bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h/' || to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS cell FROM base GROUP BY member, size_bucket ORDER BY member, CASE size_bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: 失敗 build 清單（無 cause）
panels.description: 對照月報第 7 項。cause 分類待 schema + classifier 接入後再加。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', pr_created_at) AS time, size_bucket AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(first_review_at, merged_at, closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - ready_at)) / 3600.0) AS value FROM dpv_pull_requests WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bucket IS NOT NULL AND (first_review_at IS NOT NULL OR merged_at IS NOT NULL OR closed_at IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 成員互 Approve 矩陣（approved PR 數）
panels.description: 列：reviewer，欄：PR 作者。同一 PR 同一 reviewer 多次 approve 只算一次。

targets.rawSql: SELECT reviewer, author, COUNT(DISTINCT pr_id) AS approved_prs FROM dpv_reviews WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND state = 'approved' GROUP BY reviewer, author ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 善心人士排行（群組內成員 comment 數，不含 AI 帳號）
panels.description: 統計群組內成員在其他成員 PR 上的 commented review 數，由多到少排列。

targets.rawSql: SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS comments FROM dpv_reviews WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND state = 'commented' AND reviewer_account NOT LIKE '%[bot]%' AND reviewer_account <> author_account GROUP BY reviewer ORDER BY comments DESC

panels.title: 高延遲 PR 清單（review latency 由高到低）
panels.description: 含未 review PR（lower bound）。latency_h 欄位點擊可開啟 GitHub PR。

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS "date", member, repo, status AS "state", external_id AS "build", branch, duration_seconds / 60.0 AS "duration_min", CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds / 60.0 * 0.008 ELSE 0 END AS "cost_usd" FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND is_failure AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 成員失敗率週趨勢（overall，%）
panels.description: 每人每週的 overall 失敗率（跨所有 repo）。排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS week, member AS metric, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELED') AS denom, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED') AS fails FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND member ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT week AS time, metric, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN ROUND(fails::numeric * 100 / denom, 1) ELSE NULL END AS value FROM base ORDER BY 1, 2

list.label: Group
list.definition: SELECT slug FROM dp_groups ORDER BY slug
list.query: SELECT slug FROM dp_groups ORDER BY slug

list.name: member
list.label: Member
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT display_name FROM dp_members m JOIN dp_groups_members gm ON gm.member_id = m.id JOIN dp_groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT display_name FROM dp_members m JOIN dp_groups_members gm ON gm.member_id = m.id JOIN dp_groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') ORDER BY 1
